title: 第1355章 惨烈大战大萧皇朝的杀手锏出场第1354章 双方开始交战主帅之间的博弈
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
不过短短几分钟的功夫，大萧皇朝和大魏皇朝两军阵前的试探便已分出了高下。
大萧皇朝的先锋军如同出笼的猛兽，箭雨如蝗一般，带着撕裂空气的尖啸，
狠狠砸向大魏皇朝的阵地。
反观大魏皇朝一方，箭矢数量，可准头就不敢恭维了，
甚至有几支羽箭在飞行途中便因力道不足而摇摇欲坠，
未及敌阵便无力坠地。
这不仅是箭矢质量的云泥之别，更是双方国力底蕴最直观的写照。
大魏皇朝的先锋军，名义上仍是威震天下的“最三卫”，
可明眼人都看得出来，这不过是一具被抽去了脊梁的空壳而已。
昔日那些在尸山血海中淬炼出的百战精锐，
早已被人魔城南阳王府的连番绞杀消耗殆尽。
如今的兵卒，不过是从大魏都城的武者中匆匆拼凑的乌合之众，
众人的修为驳杂，眼神也是冷漠、涣散，早已没了当年的铁血军魂。
“杀！杀！杀！.......”
随着一声令下，
两军轰然对撞。
金铁交鸣的爆响瞬间炸裂，却压不住大魏军阵深处那一丝慌乱溃散的杂音。
大萧皇朝的先锋军的士卒个个双目赤红，咆哮着如狼群般向前碾压，
那股凶煞之气仿佛要吞天噬地。
反观大魏皇朝的士兵，手中长矛剧烈颤抖，脚下步伐不由自主地向后畏缩。

仅仅十余息，大魏防线便如薄冰般遭遇重锤，
裂痕遍布，眼看就要被这股钢铁洪流彻底撕碎。
“顶上去！不想死的都给我顶上去！”
大魏皇朝先锋主将嘶吼着，不得不提前投入预备队，
才勉强堵住了那个即将溃烂的缺口。
......
与此同时，两翼的战况更是惨烈。
大魏的炎龙铁骑与炎魔铁骑，
此刻正面对着大萧皇朝最强三卫之一的最强战力的金龙卫。
这简直是单方面的屠杀。
如今的大魏皇朝铁骑，除了胯下战马还是原装货，马背上的骑士早已换了一茬又一茬。
面对金龙卫那如金色闪电般的冲锋，
所谓的“炎龙”与“炎魔”脆弱得如同纸糊，
content_en:
However, in just a few minutes, the two armies of the Great Xiao Dynasty and the Great Wei Dynasty were tested in front of the battle formations, and they had already distinguished themselves.
The vanguard army of the Great Xiao Dynasty was like a ferocious beast emerging from the cage, with arrows raining like locusts, with a scream that ripped through the air.
It hit the Wei Dynasty's position hard.
On the other hand, for the Wei Dynasty, the number of arrows but their accuracy cannot be complimented.
Some of the arrows even staggered due to lack of strength during flight.
Before reaching the enemy's formation, it fell to the ground without strength.
This is not only a difference in the quality of arrows, but also the most intuitive portrayal of the national strength of both sides.
The vanguard army of the Wei Dynasty is still nominally the most powerful "three guards" in the world.
But anyone with a discerning eye can see that this is just an empty shell with its backbone removed.
Those elite warriors who were forged in the mountains of corpses and seas of blood in the past,
It has long been exhausted by the successive strangulations of the Nanyang Prince's Mansion in the Demonic City.
Today's soldiers are just a ragtag group hastily cobbled together from the warriors in the capital of Wei.
Everyone's cultivation levels were mixed, their eyes were cold and distracted, and they had long since lost the iron-blooded military spirit of the past.
"Kill! Kill! Kill!..."
With an order,
The two armies collided violently.
The explosion of gold and iron exploded instantly, but it could not suppress the panic and disintegrating noise deep in the Wei army formation.
The soldiers of the vanguard army of the Great Xiao Dynasty all had red eyes, roaring and crushing forward like a pack of wolves.
That ferocious aura seemed to swallow up the sky and the earth.
On the other hand, the soldiers of the Wei Dynasty trembled violently with their spears in their hands, and involuntarily shrank back at their feet.
In just over ten breaths, the Wei defense line was hit hard like thin ice.
There were cracks everywhere, and it was about to be completely torn apart by this torrent of steel.
"Get on top! Anyone who doesn't want to die, get on top of me!"
The vanguard general of the Wei Dynasty roared and had to join the reserve team in advance.
Just barely blocked the gap that was about to fester.
...
At the same time, the fighting situation on both wings was even more tragic.
The Yanlong cavalry and the Flame Demon cavalry of the Wei Dynasty,
At this moment, he was facing the most powerful Golden Dragon Guard, one of the three strongest guards in the Great Xiao Dynasty.
This is simply a one-sided massacre.
Today's iron cavalry of the Wei Dynasty are still original except for the war horses under their crotches, and the knights on the horses have been changed one after another.
Facing the golden lightning-like charge of the Golden Dragon Guard,
The so-called "Fire Dragon" and "Fire Demon" are as fragile as paper.
